r each digit d is 2d·s − d², which ranks digits the same way as −(s − d)². So greedy decoding emits exactly the digit s computed in step 3. The `+` and `=` tokens get a score of −10⁴ so they are never chosen.

Because all the arithmetic is exact, the model should be correct on every pair of 5-digit inputs, not just the 200 scored examples. I only measured the 200.

Final model: `interpretable_transformers_lib/CarryLookaheadExact.py` (identical to `interpretable_transformer.py`), 200/200 correct.
